Name: NPC_THINK_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the parameters for enemy AI.

Fields.Name: Logic Script ID
Fields.Description: The AI script that drives this enemy.

Fields.Name: Battle Goal ID
Fields.Description: The combat script this enemy runs in battle.

Fields.Name: Battle Distance: Short (metres)
Fields.Description: Targets closer than this count as near. The enemy picks close-range attacks.

Fields.Name: Battle Distance: Medium (metres)
Fields.Description: Targets closer than this count as mid-range. The enemy picks mid-range attacks.

Fields.Name: Battle Distance: Long (metres)
Fields.Description: Targets closer than this count as far. The enemy picks ranged attacks.

Fields.Name: Battle Distance: End (metres)
Fields.Description: Targets past this are out of range. The enemy stops trying combat moves.

Fields.Name: Goal Duration on Wall Collision (seconds)
Fields.Description: How long this enemy keeps walking home after hitting a barrier. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Caution State: Goal ID
Fields.Description: What this enemy does when it grows wary.

Fields.Name: Action ID on Blocked Movement
Fields.Description: The attack this enemy uses when rubble blocks its path.

Fields.Name: Search State: Goal ID
Fields.Description: What this enemy does when it spots a target.

Fields.Name: Call for Help: Animation ID (Respond)
Fields.Description: The gesture this enemy plays when answering a call for help.

Fields.Name: Call for Help: Animation ID (Call)
Fields.Description: The gesture this enemy plays when calling for help.

Fields.Name: Visual Search Distance (metres)
Fields.Description: How far this enemy sees. In metres.

Fields.Name: Auditory Search Distance (metres)
Fields.Description: How far this enemy hears. Set in centimetres.

Fields.Name: Auditory Dampening Distance (metres)
Fields.Description: Past this distance, sounds fade and may go unheard. In metres.

Fields.Name: Olfactory Search Distance (metres)
Fields.Description: How far this enemy smells the player. In metres.

Fields.Name: Battle Act: Return Home Distance (metres)
Fields.Description: Past this distance from home, this enemy always turns back. In metres.

Fields.Name: Battle Act: Return Home Distance (Combat) (metres)
Fields.Description: Past this distance from home, this enemy fights while falling back. In metres.

Fields.Name: Battle Act: Return Home Abort Distance (metres)
Fields.Description: Past this distance, this enemy gives up going home and keeps fighting. In metres.

Fields.Name: Battle Act: Non-Combat Act Duration (seconds)
Fields.Description: How long this enemy waits before acting on a sensed target. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Return Home: Target Look-At Duration (seconds)
Fields.Description: How long this enemy watches its target while walking home. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Return Home: Target Look-At Distance (metres)
Fields.Description: How far this enemy watches its target while walking home. In metres.

Fields.Name: Visual Target Forget Duration (frames)
Fields.Description: How long this enemy remembers a seen target. In frames.

Fields.Name: Auditory Target Forget Duration (frames)
Fields.Description: How long this enemy remembers a heard target. In frames.

Fields.Name: Battle Start Distance (metres)
Fields.Description: How close a spotted target must be before this enemy attacks. In metres.

Fields.Name: Call for Help: Respond Friend Group ID
Fields.Description: This enemy's friend group. It answers calls from this group.

Fields.Name: Call for Help: Call Friend Group ID
Fields.Description: The friend group this enemy calls to. Only that group answers.

Fields.Name: Damage Effect Rate
Fields.Description: How strongly pain draws this enemy's focus. The exact effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Team Attack Weight
Fields.Description: Share of the 100-point attacker budget this enemy takes. When attackers' shares reach 100, no more join in. Higher values mean fewer simultaneous attackers.

Fields.Name: Visual Search: Horizontal Angle (degrees)
Fields.Description: How tall the sight cone is. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Visual Search: Vertical Angle (degrees)
Fields.Description: How wide the sight cone is. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Auditory Search: Horizontal Angle (degrees)
Fields.Description: How tall the hearing cone is. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Auditory Search: Vertical Angle (degrees)
Fields.Description: How wide the hearing cone is. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Call for Help: Minimum Distance to Target (metres)
Fields.Description: This enemy cannot call for help closer to its target than this. In metres.

Fields.Name: Call for Help: Maximum Distance to Friend (metres)
Fields.Description: Friends past this cannot hear the call. In metres.

Fields.Name: Call for Help: Respond Duration (seconds)
Fields.Description: How long a called friend stays alert after answering. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Call for Help: Minimum Delay (ms)
Fields.Description: Shortest wait before a called friend responds. Set in tenths of a second, so 101 means 10.1 seconds.

Fields.Name: Call for Help: Maximum Delay (ms)
Fields.Description: Longest wait before a called friend responds. Set in tenths of a second, so 101 means 10.1 seconds.

Fields.Name: Caution State: Goal Action
Fields.Description: What this enemy does the moment it grows wary.

Fields.Name: Search State: Goal Action
Fields.Description: What this enemy does the moment it spots a target.

Fields.Name: Call for Help: Post-Response Action Type
Fields.Description: How a called friend moves to the caller.

Fields.Name: Disable Path Movement
Fields.Description: If ON, this enemy walks straight at its goal. It ignores paths and may hit walls.

Fields.Name: Skip Arrival Line of Sight Check
Fields.Description: If ON, this enemy counts itself arrived without seeing its goal.

Fields.Name: Is Entourage
Fields.Description: If ON, this enemy plays a follower role.

Fields.Name: Can Navigate: Cliff
Fields.Description: If ON, this enemy can cross cliff paths.

Fields.Name: Can Navigate: Wide
Fields.Description: If ON, this enemy can cross wide paths.

Fields.Name: Can Navigate: Ladder
Fields.Description: If ON, this enemy can climb ladders.

Fields.Name: Can Navigate: Hole
Fields.Description: If ON, this enemy can drop through holes.

Fields.Name: Can Navigate: Door
Fields.Description: If ON, this enemy can pass through doors.

Fields.Name: Can Navigate: In the Wall
Fields.Description: If ON, this enemy can move inside walls.
